subject: Signoff: Comp exception request for Senior Inference Engineer, Devon Park
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Comp worksheet + exception request — Senior Inference Engineer (Devon Park)

Hi team,

Following the onsite loop for Devon Park (hired via TalentMatch), Vivek is asking for a comp exception to go above the published IC4 band. Hiring manager summary: exceptional system-level inference experience, shipped latency/quantization wins at scale, and a strong cultural fit. Candidate is considering counteroffers and we've agreed to move quickly if we can meet the ask.

Recommendation (from Vivek): base $210,000, sign-on $30,000 (one-time), equity 0.35% 4y. This is ~12% above the top of the IC4 band in our current worksheet. Attached: comp_worksheet_DevonPark.xlsx and a draft offer doc.

Request: Lauren or Mina, can you review and confirm who needs to sign this exception? We need formal signoff and final language by EOD Tuesday PST to hit Devon's timeline.

Attachments: comp_worksheet_DevonPark.xlsx (worksheet with market comps + manager justification), offer_draft_DevonPark.docx

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp worksheet + exception request — Senior Inference Engineer (Devon Park)

+1 to the recommendation. Devon led the inference runtime at their last company; they reduced p99 decoding latency by ~30% and drove a quantization path we still want to copy. We discussed comp vs equity mix and candidate prefers more base given relocation.

Business justification: this hire shortens our model latency roadmap by ~6 months and enables the mobile/edge SKU we committed to Q3. I can sign off on the manager justification; seeking your approval on the comp exception.

Vivek
VP of Engineering, Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp worksheet + exception request — Senior Inference Engineer (Devon Park)

Thanks — I reviewed the worksheet. Market comps in SF for this profile support the higher base in the recommendation. Per our comp policy, anything >10% above band requires VP People (Lauren) approval AND signoff from Finance for budget reallocation.

Action items for signoff:
- Lauren: formal approval for band exception (can be email reply)
- Jonas: please confirm whether we have budget headroom in Q1 hiring plan to absorb the delta (cc'd)
- Laura: confirm candidate timeline and whether sign-on must be within 30 days of start.

I can prepare the official exception form once Lauren confirms.

Mina Haddad
Compensation & Benefits
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Thanks for the clear rationale. I approve a one-time band exception for Devon Park as requested: base $210,000, $30,000 sign-on (one-time), 0.35% equity over 4 years. Conditions:
- Compensation exception form completed and attached to the offer folder (Laura, please upload).
- Final offer must include standard relocation clause and the usual 30-day sign-on payment window.
- For transparency, add a short note in the candidate file explaining business justification and manager contributions.

Please proceed. Laura, if you could send the signed offer to TalentMatch with the attached draft and copy me, that should close the loop.

Lauren Bishop
VP People Operations
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

- Base: $210,000
- One-time sign-on: $30,000
